definitions.survey_distance: Sum of selected whole-way survey extents; overlapping geometry is not deduplicated. Not travel distance, elapsed time or measured effort.
definitions.usable_gain: Saved cumulative_usable_gain_km: total increase in thresholded eligible-network usable length, including qualifying selected and pre-existing mass.
definitions.prefix_rule: Longest complete ranked prefix whose recorded cumulative survey extent is at most the budget. No fractional ways, skipped unaffordable next ways, re-optimisation or extrapolation.
definitions.common_range: Zero to the minimum of the three recorded final survey extents.
definitions.fairness: Equal recorded survey distance is not equal task count or equal survey time, and the all-positive scenario is not realised yield.
definitions.recovered_preexisting_limit: Per-prefix qualifying selected mass is not saved. Recovered-pre-existing curves cannot be obtained by subtracting selected own/survey distance from total usable gain.

rounding.per_row_distance: The main CSV contains per-row survey_km (own_km fallback), not cumulative distance. Decimal summation avoids binary-boundary errors but accumulates the exported 3-decimal rounding.
rounding.cumulative_distance: The other CSVs supply independently rounded cumulative_survey_km; these are used directly, not reconstructed by summing own_km.
rounding.budget_boundary_limit: Prefix membership is exact only for the recorded rounded values. A boundary or zero-distance tie may move at unrounded precision; ties do not denote genuinely free surveys.
rounding.reported_half_widths: Assuming nearest rounding, main prefix distance has at most n × 0.0005 km rounding error; a saved cumulative distance or gain has at most 0.0005 km. These are rounding bounds, not confidence intervals.

eligible_lau_coverage.definition: Independent municipality-layer assignments divided by corrected national eligible lengths

spatial_assignment: Independent representative-point assignment per layer; whole-way lengths use the middle stored way node, without boundary clipping. Boundary points are included with one deterministic owner per layer. Coarse polygons are not an exact hierarchical partition; unmatched totals are reported.

corrected_model_impact.limitations: Greece only: international country/profile results and downstream exposure, campaign, targeting and geographic analyses still use the frozen model. Snapshot, configuration and eligible-length frame are held fixed; old and corrected percentages are model-conditional, not physical accessibility. Frozen native threshold/scope artifact execution linkage remains unverified; the new run record does not establish its past command or time.

frozen_evidence.audit_draw: results/census/audit_sample.csv (frozen original draw, not corrected sampler output)
frozen_evidence.point_pilot: results/analysis/continuity_audit.json (old ranked ways, not corrected worklist)
frozen_evidence.imagery: results/mapillary and results/analysis/mapillary_radius_sensitivity.* (original geometry/scope; not regenerated by the corrected census)
frozen_evidence.historical_comparator: results/analysis/corrected_model_impact.* (frozen Greek baseline against the corrected Greek run)
